gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-pt-sans-caption: Commanding vintage swagger sits up top in Woodgod, its lowercase climbing nearly to the capitals. And PT Sans Caption, a plain sans with big-bodied letters and inviting bowls, gives the eye somewhere easy to land.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-puritan: Tall, stamped and a bit old-fashioned: that's Woodgod, with a wide channel cut into every bowl. Puritan follows in rounded, open forms with oversized e and a counters, so a long passage goes down smoothly.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-questrial: Commanding is how Woodgod looks, its tall lowercase nearly touching the capitals and every bowl cut wide. But Questrial does the quieter job, with open c, e and s shapes in a flat, single-weight sans-serif line.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada keeps lowercase c, s and z standing tall and full, with a marker-tip line that opens at every curve's end. Woodgod's vintage display bite is the sharper contrast to it.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-radio-canada-big: Woodgod is all vintage command, with tall lowercase and wide-cut bowls. Radio Canada Big follows with a dowel-like monoline sans-serif whose x-height fills the line and whose terminals finish clear of the stem, so a long passage moves along without snagging.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-readex-pro: Professional and level in tone, Readex Pro keeps broad gaps at its terminals and a steady weight from word to word under Woodgod's vintage display. Their strongest quality is the gap in character.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-roboto: Tall lowercase nearly matching its capitals gives Woodgod a commanding, vintage stance. Roboto takes over below with generous mouths on its round letters, so a long passage reads cleanly and without fuss.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-ruda: Ruda reads wide-mouthed and wire-thin, with a sizable x-height. Pair it with Woodgod's commanding vintage display and the strongest quality is how a heavy, wide-cut heading sits over such a light, approachable plain sans.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-saira: Saira reads clearly, with a see-through gap in each s and rounded letters stretching toward the top line. Saira's sans-serif text would carry a long passage easily beneath Woodgod's commanding, vintage heading and its tall lowercase.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-sarpanch: Stamped, tall and unmistakably vintage, Woodgod comes in with wide-cut bowls and a commanding lowercase. Sarpanch, a plain sans with a clearly open e and compact ascenders, sits beneath it as the friendlier voice.
